title: parapet-ai/parapet
summary: Parapet-ai/Parapet 是一个本地优先的AI代理框架，具有5层容器加固。它可以在本地运行Ollama模型，无需云服务、遥测或API密钥。通过iptables、DNS水坑、seccomp和只读rootfs提供安全保护，支持离线推理。
description: Local-first AI agent framework with 5-layer container hardening. Runs Ollama models offline behind iptables, DNS sinkhole, seccomp, and read-only rootfs. No cloud, no telemetry, no API keys.
